note: South Sudan: every foreign employee must hold a work permit approved by the Ministry of Labour (Labour Act 2017, art. 46(3)), which a circular of December 2025 told employers to verify. No days without it. From a radio station's report of the circular.

sources.title: Eye Radio, Labour ministry orders crackdown on illegal foreign employment (December 2025)
sources.said: The Ministry cited Article 46(3) of the Labour Act 2017, which mandates that all foreign employees in South Sudan must possess an approved work permit.
